text: Coffee with Ahmed. His daughter starts reception on 3 September 2026, he's more nervous than she is. Remind me to text him that morning.
sophie got the promotion!! senior designer from jan. her mum's apparently telling the whole street lol
Yuki's last day at the bank is Friday 30 October 2026. Leaving drinks the same evening, I said I'd go.
Call w/ Emily - her son Jack sits his GCSEs May 2027, she's already stressing about revision timetables. Check in with her a week after the mocks.

so I was talking to Saanvi and um her brother Arjun graduated last week from Leeds, engineering, first class apparently, she was so proud, and she said he's moving to Bristol for a grad scheme the month after, starting in December, and he's a massive climbing nerd so maybe something climbing related if I see him
Pooja - husband retiring end of March 2027 after 32 yrs at the council. Big party planned, she's doing the food. Don't forget to get a card for him.
Abdi started at the hospital Monday. Says it's chaos but good chaos.

ok so Mila's twins start nursery 7 Sept, the one by the park, mornings only to start with. She's dreading the drop off, Lila cried for a week when she started at that age apparently. Mila's going back to work part time the week after so it all has to work. Ask her how it went the next day and maybe offer to do a pick up
Lila - hates fish, allergic to cashews. Works in HR at a law firm.
Jen's dad passed his driving theory test at 64!! she's thrilled. practical in Feb 2027
Rang Yetunde. Her mum's surgery got moved to 12 November 2026, she's flying back to Lagos the day before. Need to message her afterwards to see how her mum's doing.
Tadhg's leaving do was meant to be Thurs but it's been called off, his start date got pushed so he's staying on till Christmas. Still going to the pub Thursday anyway.
Antoine Moreau, new head of sales, started this week. Into cycling, rides to work from Clapham. Wife's a teacher.
demi said her little girl lost her first tooth today and got £2 from the tooth fairy. inflation lol
Must book the dentist and sort the car tax before the 1st.
Lunch with Lwazi. He's interviewing for the deputy head job on 4 Nov 2026 and he's really anxious about the presentation part. Text him good luck the night before, then ask how it went afterwards.
Yusuf's son Malik got into Manchester for medicine, offer came through yesterday. Yusuf can't stop smiling
Chiara's sister is graduating in Bologna in July 2027, whole family's going. Chiara wants to take a week off after.
Keisha first day at the new agency was Monday. Ring her Friday to see how week one went
Yaw & his partner are both starting new jobs in January, same week. They're moving to Leeds the weekend before.
Quick one - Luis mentioned his nan turns 90 on 14 December 2026. He's organising a surprise lunch at her favourite Portuguese place. Get her a card, sign it from both of us.
Bruno's dog Pepper is coming to the office from now on. He's a beagle. Bruno loves him more than people.
Magda says her eldest's doing her A level art exhibition March 2027. She paints, mostly portraits. Want to go.
Note to self: stop agreeing to Saturday shifts.
Talked to Anjali Shah after the meeting. Her husband's been made redundant, finishes on the 20th. She's holding it together but only just. I should check in with her next week.
Bridget retires 31 December 2026!!! 40 yrs nursing. Collection going round, chip in by the 15th
Julien's son started secondary school this week, hated day one, loved day two. Julien says he's into robotics club now.

Wiremu said his mum's coming over from Auckland in February 2027 for a month. First time she's left NZ. He's taking her to Edinburgh the week after she lands, then down to see his sister Mila in Cornwall. She's vegetarian and doesn't like flying much so he's worried about the 24 hours on the plane. He wants recommendations for somewhere nice to eat in Edinburgh, I said I'd send him a list.

Rachel - promoted to partner. Announced today, first woman in the Leeds office to make it. Her wife's throwing a party Saturday, I'm invited. Bring wine, she drinks white. Their son Arjun's back from uni for it too, he's doing law at Durham now and apparently wants to work with Rachel one day. She pretended to hate the idea but was clearly delighted.
remind me to ask emily how jack's mocks went
Ahmed's wife Pooja is expecting again, due August 2027. He mentioned it really casually like it wasn't news

voice note: right so Sophie rang, her brother Tadhg's graduation is tomorrow and she's driving down to Exeter that morning, and then she's back the day after and she wants to do dinner on the Sunday, so I need to keep Sunday free and ask her how the ceremony went

Yuki starts her new role at Sony on 2 November 2026. She's a bit terrified tbh, it's her first management job and she's inheriting a team of eight, two of whom applied for the same role. Her partner's away that whole week with work too, so she'll be on her own with the kids. Text her the evening before to say good luck, and maybe drop off some food that weekend.
Saanvi's daughter Lila's ballet exam is a week Saturday. Saanvi's more stressed than Lila
Pooja and Abdi got engaged!! at the top of Snowdon. wedding probably summer 2028
Mila's not doing the half marathon anymore, knee's gone again. Physio twice a week.
Lila's brother Julien just finished his PhD, viva passed with minor corrections. She wants to get him something nice, he collects vinyl.
Jen - her boss is leaving end of Nov and she's been asked to act up. She's not sure she wants it. Talk to her about it at the weekend.
Groceries, bin day Tues, return the parcel.
Yetunde's son Yaw got his GCSE results in August, all 7s and above. She's still bragging. Fair enough.
Tadhg's retiring dad (Uncle Bruno to everyone) has his do on 6 Dec 2026, Tadhg's giving a speech and is dreading it. Remind me to message him the morning of.
Antoine's daughter is starting uni in Lyon in September 2027. He's already planning to drive her down and stay a few days afterwards.

Demi's partner Jack has been offered a job in Dubai, they've got till Friday to decide. She's torn. Her kids are 6 and 9 so it's a big deal, the eldest has just got into the school choir and is finally settled. Her mum lives round the corner and does all the school pick ups, so that'd go too. Demi kept saying it's an amazing opportunity for him but she didn't sound convinced.
Lwazi: got the deputy head job!! starts after Easter. Send congrats
chat w yusuf, wife's retiring next june, he wants to take her to japan for it. loves gardens, temples, tea

Chiara's leaving the firm, last day 18 Dec. Going freelance, mostly brand work, and she's already got two clients lined up for January. Her husband's a bit worried about money but she's buzzing. She said no fuss for her last day, but the team are doing lunch that afternoon anyway and I'm organising the card. Chiara drinks Aperol, loves anything with lemons on.
Keisha's cat Biscuit has to have a tooth out Tues. Keisha's anxious, cat's 14. Text her after.
Interview at Kowalski & Partners on Thursday 29 October 2026, 10am. Iron the shirt the night before.
Malik passed his driving test first time! Yusuf's taking him out to celebrate this weekend
Yaw's mum's had a fall, she's in hospital in Kumasi. He's going out next week, not sure for how long. Need to call him before he flies.
Spoke to Luis Fernández about the job. He starts with us 16 November 2026, first two weeks shadowing Bruno. Lives in Croydon, two kids.
Bruno and Magda's anniversary is 5 March, 10 years in 2027. Magda's dropping hints about a weekend in Lisbon.
Jack's starting his apprenticeship Monday — Emily said he's weirdly calm. Good.
Anjali's mum's 70th birthday is 2 January 2027, Anjali's doing a big family meal the day after. Her mum loves orchids.
Bridget mentioned her granddaughter's christening is in March 2027, she's godmother. Very chuffed.
So Julien rang about the hen do, it's off, Rachel and Luis split up last month. Julien's gutted for her. Should send Rachel a message, nothing heavy.
Wiremu has a 6-month review Friday, he thinks it's going to be fine but his manager's new. Ask him how it went Monday
Rachel's niece starts primary school next week. Rachel bought her a unicorn lunchbox, very on brand.
Ahmed's brother Yusuf (Yus) is staying with him for a month while he job hunts. Ahmed's happy about it, his kids less so.

Long call with Sophie tonight. Her mum got the all clear after the scan on 12 October 2026, so huge relief all round. Her dad's retiring in the spring, probably April 2027, and they're planning a big trip to Canada the month after to see her aunt. Sophie's thinking of going with them for part of it. Also she's still mad keen on bouldering. Remind me to send her that climbing wall link.
